rationale.root_cause: _is_forex_market_closed lives in adapters.ctrader.market_hours (line 32: datetime.now(timezone.utc)). The 9 boundary tests patched adapters.ctrader.forward_test_engine.datetime — the wrong module — so the patch had no effect and the tests asserted against real datetime.now(). On 2026-09-09 (Wednesday, market open) 5 of 9 failed; on a real closed day they would all silently pass.
fix_layers: 1. _PATCH_TARGET class attribute centralises the patch target at adapters.ctrader.market_hours.datetime.
2. All 9 boundary tests now use the class attribute (single source of truth).

3. New test_patch_target_must_target_market_hours pins the correct target with a Saturday fixture (deterministically closed). Reverting to forward_test_engine.datetime would fail loudly the next time the suite runs.

4. Two boundary tests had stale expectations left over from before cc50ae64 (2026-07-06, weekend market-closed fix): test_friday_at_close_minute (21:55 UTC) and test_monday_before_open (Mon 00:00). Updated to the cc50ae64-correct boundaries (Friday 22:00 close; Monday always open) and renamed to reflect new semantics.
rationale.out_of_scope_explanation: AC #3 forbids modifying reconnect/feed implementation. The 7 remaining reconnect-class failures are pre-existing MagicMock JSON serialization issues — same failures on main baseline. Card explicitly defers them to f37e7b74.
